changed.title: Find a bounded nonlinear-depth selector exceeding the two-binomial-sum rank budget
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∃ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let budget := fun (t b : ℕ) =>
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1)) +
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b-1), Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1))
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    represents C ∧ depth (n+m) C ≤ d+1 ∧
    budget (C.gates.countP nonlinear) (2^d) < A.rank

changed.title: A fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit for the unrestricted shared-key witness moment at any order and fixed schedule
changed.statement:
∀ (k r h t : ℕ), 0 < h → h ≤ k → 0 < t →
  let rot := fun (d x : ℕ) => ((x <<< (d % k)) ||| (x >>> (k-d % k))) % 2^k
  let chi := fun (x : ℕ) => (List.range k).foldl (fun (acc i : ℕ) =>
    acc ||| ((xor (x.testBit i) (!(x.testBit ((i+1) % k)) && x.testBit ((i+2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let run := fun (masks : ℕ → Fin (2^k)) (col : Bool) (key name : ℕ) =>
    let gap : ℕ := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.range r).foldl (fun z j =>
      let mixed := z ^^^ rot gap z ^^^ rot (k-gap % k) z
      chi mixed ^^^ rot (if col then 3*(j+1)+1 else 2*j) key ^^^
        (masks (if col then r+j else j)).val) (rot (if col then 3 else 1) key ^^^ name)
  let B := if r = 0 then 2 else if r = 1 then 7 else 7*r-2
  let seam := fun (b : ℕ) => min k (h+b-k)
  let A := 2^(B+seam B+1)
  let scan := 2^(10*r+seam (4*r)+seam (6*r)+2) * Nat.choose (t+A-1) t
  let wiresIn := 2*r*k+2*h
  let bits := fun (len word : ℕ) => (List.range len).map (fun i => word.testBit i)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (out : Fin ((t+2)*k+1) → Fin (wiresIn+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack wiresIn C ∧
    C.output < wiresIn+C.size ∧
    C.size ≤ 1048576*((k+1)*(r+1)*(t+2))^4 * min (2^(3*k)) scan ∧
    ∀ (masks : ℕ → Fin (2^k)) (a b : Fin (2^h)),
      let input := (List.range (2*r)).flatMap (fun j => bits k (masks j).val) ++
        bits h a.val ++ bits h b.val
      let num := fun (x y : Fin (2^k)) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun key : Fin (2^k) =>
        (run masks false key.val x.val >>> (k-h)) = a.val ∧
        (run masks true key.val y.val >>> (k-h)) = b.val)).card
      let moment := ∑ x : Fin (2^k), ∑ y : Fin (2^k), (num x y)^t
      ∀ j : Fin ((t+2)*k+1), (C.wires input).getD (out j).val false = moment.testBit j.val

changed.title: Subexponential circuits count and index histogram witnesses with live pin permissions on every matching layout
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t : ℕ,
  let n := t+1
  let I := Fin n
  let J := Fin (n+1)
  let V := Bool × I
  let W := Fin (2*n+1)
  let K := Fin (4*n)
  let P := V → Option Bool
  let hist := fun (σ : Equiv.Perm I) (p : P) (r b : J) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      (∀ v, p v = none ∨ p v = some (x v)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i))).card = r.val ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,σ i))).card = b.val)).card
  let raw := fun (x : V → Bool) => List.ofFn (fun i : I => x (false,i)) ++ List.ofFn (fun i : I => x (true,i))
  let tag := fun (o : Option Bool) => if o.isSome then 1+(o.getD false).toNat else 0
  let val := fun (z : K → Bool) => ∑ k : K, (z k).toNat * 2^k.val
  let key := fun (p : P) => ∑ v : V, tag (p v) * 3^(v.2.val + (if v.1 then n else 0))
  let inputs := 2+n*n+6*n+(n+1)*(n+1)*(2*n+1)+8*n
  ∃ (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (num ord : K → Fin (inputs+g.size))
    (valid : Fin (inputs+g.size)) (pinWire : Bool → V → Fin (inputs+g.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs g ∧ g.size ≤ 2^(C*(Nat.sqrt n+1)) ∧
    (∀ gate ∈ g.gates, ((gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or) ∧ gate.inputs.length = 2) ∨
      (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
    ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm I) (allow : V → Fin 3 → Bool) (H : J → J → W → Bool),
      let table := fun (r b : J) => ∑ k : W, (H r b k).toNat * 2^k.val
      let fiber := (Finset.univ : Finset P).filter (fun p => hist σ p = table ∧ ∀ v, allow v (if (p v).isSome then (if (p v).getD false then 2 else 1) else 0) = true)
      let countBits := (List.ofFn (fun r : J => (List.ofFn (fun b : J => List.ofFn (H r b))).flatten)).flatten
      let permBits := (List.ofFn (fun i : I => List.ofFn (fun j : I => decide (σ i = j)))).flatten
      let allowBits := (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin 3 => raw (fun v => allow v k))).flatten
      ∃ e : Fin fiber.card ≃ {p : P // p ∈ fiber},
        (∀ i j : Fin fiber.card, i < j → key (e i).val < key (e j).val) ∧
        ∀ (p : P) (junk : V → Bool) (z : K → Bool),
        let ws := g.wires ([false,true] ++ permBits ++ allowBits ++ countBits ++ raw (fun v => (p v).isSome) ++
          raw (fun v => (p v).getD (junk v)) ++ List.ofFn z)
        let q : P := fun v => if ws.getD (pinWire false v).val false then some (ws.getD (pinWire true v).val false) else none
        val (fun k => ws.getD (num k).val false) = fiber.card ∧
          (ws.getD valid.val false = true ↔ p ∈ fiber) ∧
          ∀ i : Fin fiber.card,
            (p = (e i).val → val (fun k => ws.getD (ord k).val false) = i.val) ∧
            (val z = i.val → q = (e i).val)

changed.title: Three unit-cost perfect matchings encode signed parity equations with a uniform distance bound
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (v m : ℕ) (ep : Fin m → Bool → Fin v) (rhs : Fin m → Bool),
  let X := Fin v → Bool
  let add := fun (a b : Bool) => decide (a ≠ b)
  let bad := fun (x : X) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Fin m =>
    add (x (ep e false)) (x (ep e true)) ≠ rhs e)).card
  let deg := fun (j : Fin v) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin m × Bool => ep p.1 p.2 = j)).card
  ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ C*(v+m) ∧
    let V := Bool × Fin n
    let Y := V → Bool
    ∃ (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (owner : Fin n → Fin v) (neg : Fin n → Bool)
      (dec : Y → X),
      (∀ j : Fin v,
        let pos := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => owner i = j ∧ neg i = false)).card
        let inv := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => owner i = j ∧ neg i = true)).card
        0 < pos ∧ pos = inv ∧ pos + inv ≤ C*(1+deg j)) ∧
      let enc := fun (x : X) (p : V) => add (x (owner p.2)) (neg p.2)
      let cost := fun (y : Y) =>
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) ≠ y (true,i))).card +
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) ≠ y (true,σ i))).card +
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) = y (true,τ i))).card
      (∀ x : X, dec (enc x) = x ∧ cost (enc x) = 2 * bad x) ∧
      ∀ y : Y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : V => y p ≠ enc (dec y) p)).card +
        C*(2*bad (dec y)) ≤ C*cost y

changed.title: A polynomial-time writer turns native binary CNF into ternary binary constraints with exactly one extension per satisfying assignment
changed.statement:
let bits := fun (w v : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun j => v.testBit j)
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let width := fun n : Nat => n.log2+1
let Ban := (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat)
let legal := fun (n : Nat) (B : List Ban) => 2 ≤ n ∧ ∀ e ∈ B,
  e.1.1 < e.2.1 ∧ e.2.1 < n ∧ e.1.2 < 3 ∧ e.2.2 < 3
let enc := fun (n : Nat) (B : List Ban) =>
  header n ++ B.flatMap (fun e => bits (width n) e.1.1 ++ bits 2 e.1.2 ++
    bits (width n) e.2.1 ++ bits 2 e.2.2)
let valid := fun (n : Nat) (B : List Ban) (a : Fin n → Fin 3) =>
  let v := List.ofFn (fun j => (a j).val)
  ∀ e ∈ B, v.getD e.1.1 3 ≠ e.1.2 ∨ v.getD e.2.1 3 ≠ e.2.2
∃ (f : List Bool → List Bool) (C : Nat),
  (∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    (∀ j, Finite (M.tm.Γ j)) ∧ ∀ z, M.time z ≤ C*(z+1)^4) ∧
  (∀ x : List Bool, (¬ ∃ F : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF F = x) → f x = []) ∧
  ∀ F : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
    let occ := F.flatten
    let order := (occ.map Prod.fst).eraseDups
    let n := order.length+occ.length+2
    let Models := {a : Fin order.length → Bool // ∃ raw : Nat → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval raw F = true ∧ ∀ i, a i = raw (order.get i)}
    ∃ B : List Ban, legal n B ∧ f (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF F) = enc n B ∧
      B.length ≤ 9+order.length+7*occ.length+2*F.length ∧
      ∃ E : Models ≃ {a : Fin n → Fin 3 // valid n B a}, ∀ x i (j : Fin n),
        j.val = 2+i.val → ((E x).val j).val = (x.val i).toNat

changed.title: A finite-alphabet machine counts rank-four winning pairings by size in time polynomial in input length times nine and three to two defect counts
changed.statement:
let bits := fun (w v : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun j => v.testBit j)
let width := fun n : Nat => n.log2+1
let pack := fun (n : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) => List.replicate n true ++ [false] ++
  rows.flatMap (fun R => bits 3 R.length ++ R.flatMap (bits (width n)))
let well := fun (n : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) => ∀ R ∈ rows,
  R.length ≤ 4 ∧ R.Nodup ∧ ∀ v ∈ R, v < n
let linear := fun H : Finset (Finset Nat) => ∀ R ∈ H, ∀ S ∈ H, R ≠ S → (R ∩ S).card ≤ 1
∃ (f : List Bool → List Bool) (M : Turing.TM2ComputableAux Bool Bool) (C : Nat),
  (∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)) ∧
  let runs := fun (x : List Bool) (t : Nat) => Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm
    (x.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun) (some ((f x).map M.outputAlphabet.invFun)) t)
  (∀ x : List Bool, (¬ ∃ n rows, well n rows ∧ pack n rows = x) →
    f x = [] ∧ runs x (C*(x.length+1)^C)) ∧
  ∀ n rows, well n rows →
    let H := (rows.map List.toFinset).toFinset
    let small := H.filter (fun R => R.card ≤ 3)
    let q := H.card-small.card
    let count := fun s : Nat => Nat.card {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) // Function.Involutive P ∧
      (∀ R ∈ H, ∃ u : Fin n, u.val ∈ R ∧ (P u).val ∈ R ∧ P u ≠ u) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => P u ≠ u)).card = 2*s}
    let x := pack n rows
    let field := 1+n*width n
    (∀ s, count s < 2^field) ∧
    f x = (List.range (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s => bits field (count s)) ∧
    ∀ D ⊆ small, linear (small \ D) → runs x (C*(x.length+1)^C*9^q*3^D.card)
